title: The North Pier Signal
solution: AT THE NORTH PIER, TURN THE BRASS COMPASS EAST. A BLUE LANTERN MARKS THE SAFE CHANNEL TO THE TIDE VAULT.
ciphertext: IZ ZRC VAPZR FWCP, ZEPV ZRC NPIUU SAQFIUU CIUZ. I NLEC LIVZCPV QIPGU ZRC UIHC SRIVVCL ZA ZRC ZWXC JIELZ.
briefing: At the north pier, a blue lantern flashes beside an empty boat. An etched plate on its compass stand contains your next instruction. Find the safe route.
ending: You turn the brass compass east. The blue lantern marks a narrow, safe channel between the rocks. Beyond it, a stone door bears the words TIDE VAULT.
clues: The first word has two letters and is followed by ZRC. Try AT THE. The brass compass from case one matters here.
An Affine cipher changes each letter with a multiplication and an offset. It still gives each cipher letter one fixed meaning, so this board works as before.
The Affine key is multiplier 5, offset 8. Cipher Z is T, R is H, and C is E. The destination at the end reads TIDE VAULT.
